note: The bare drone drill for matching a pitch, held to 3 minutes: the low Do, then Sol, each found by sliding until the wobble against the drone stops. The why names how the drone checks the singer, the drill is sung on "oo" with one care line, and the key is moves, with a {{?key}} line on what stays the same.

exercise.title: Find the smooth spot over a drone
exercise.why: A note in tune with the drone sounds smooth and a note that is off wobbles against it, so the drone tells your ear when you are on the note.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Sing the low {{1}} on "oo". Slide a little above it and below it until the wobble stops and the sound goes smooth: that smooth spot is in tune.
Then find the smooth spot on {{5}} the same way.
Practice until you can hold the smooth spot for as long as feels easy.
_Don't reach for high notes: the low {{1}} and the {{5}} just above it are all this drill needs._
{{?key}}In another key the drone sits higher or lower, and the smooth spot sounds the same.
